scope: Aeternitas local research project, two companies and bounded annual financial / summary evidence

development.execution: Development only until implementation and review records are frozen

holdout.execution: A separate agent creates and freezes variants without sharing input or expected answers with the development implementer; root explicitly starts the first execution after development freeze
holdout.failed_first_execution: Retain the original result and hashes, fix the real defect, record case revision only if the case itself is wrong, then rerun affected cases; never rewrite first-run evidence

rule_types: Company identity and original-source derivative provenance
Disclosure dates and Shanghai news-cutoff time
Exact financial values and deterministic Decimal calculations
Conflicts and unsupported duration / currency rejection
Citation set membership and exact quotation
Role-specific evidence selection and explicit prior-role scope metadata
Bounded upstream failure status, attempt count and absence of a published report
automatic_acceptance.source_failure_transport: httpx.MockTransport exercising actual orchestration and source client

human_review.review_source: Original saved public source bytes and deterministic financial source locations
human_review.acceptance: No unmarked severe source or numeric error in sampled important claims; scope limitations and unresolved gaps are visible
human_review.reviewer_identity: Assistant engineering review is recorded separately from independent user review

design_comparison.direct_synthesis_shape: One synthesis task with at most one validation repair; unused budget is not deliberately consumed
design_comparison.predeclared_conclusion: Neither strategy is assumed superior; a small sample cannot establish general accuracy or causal performance gains

evidence_separation: Original live source API and PostgreSQL smoke
Real subscription LLM smoke and report verification
Two startup sessions with a restart and saved-history lookup
limitations: Twelve project-specific cases cannot estimate correctness across all securities or accounting policies.
Passing schema, quote and source membership rules does not establish that prose follows from evidence.
Replaying a frozen public-source derivative is offline verification, not a new live API result.
Invented failure inputs and model text are always labeled synthetic.
